chat.question: Explain the difference between a derivative and an integral with a simple example.
chat.answer: A derivative looks at how fast something changes, while an integral adds up many small changes. If a car covers 120 km in 2 hours, its average speed is 60 km/h; the integral rebuilds that distance from the speed.

cards.subject: Mathematics
cards.question: What is the derivative of f(x) = x² at x = 3?
cards.answer: 6. Since f′(x) = 2x, we get 2 × 3 = 6. The derivative is the slope of the tangent line at that point.

cards.subject: Physics
cards.question: What is the SI unit of force?
cards.answer: The newton (N). One newton is 1 kg·m/s², the force that gives a one-kilogram mass an acceleration of one metre per second squared.

cards.subject: Chemistry
cards.question: What does an element's atomic number show?
cards.answer: The number of protons in the nucleus. In a neutral atom it also equals the number of electrons.

cards.subject: English
cards.question: What is the difference between advice and advise?
cards.answer: Advice is a noun (a suggestion) and advise is a verb (to give a suggestion). Example: He gave me good advice. / I advise you to rest.

cards.subject: Dari
cards.question: In the sentence «کتاب را خواندم», which word is the object?
cards.answer: «کتاب» is the object, and «را» marks the object. The verb is «خواندم» and the subject is carried by the ending «ـم».

cards.subject: Mathematics
cards.question: What is the area of a triangle with base 6 and height 4?
cards.answer: 12. The triangle area formula is base × height ÷ 2: 6 × 4 ÷ 2 = 12.

about.title: Kankor preparation, for every student
about.copy: Abzar Kankor started from a simple question: why is it so hard to find a good, free resource for Kankor preparation? We are building exactly that.
paragraphs: Every year thousands of students in Afghanistan prepare for Kankor, but most of them rely on scattered books, handwritten notes, and expensive classes. The result is that talent gives way to luck and money.
Abzar Kankor wants to close that gap: short and organised lessons, flashcards for review, a question bank, an online school, and an AI assistant that answers questions at any hour.
about.goal: Our goal is simple: every student, one small step forward every day. Those small steps make the difference at the end.
about.quote: «No one should fall behind their dream because they lack a book or an internet connection.»

values.title: Free for everyone
values.text: We believe Kankor preparation should not depend on a family's finances.

values.title: Simple and clear
values.text: We explain every idea in the student's own language, without unnecessary jargon.

values.title: With you, not just teaching
values.text: With reminders, follow-up, and support, we stay beside you until exam day.

outcomes: Work with lists, conditions and loops

lessons.title: What is Python and why learn it?
lessons.summary: Meet Python and its real-world uses.
lessons.content:
Python is a simple, widely used language for websites, data analysis and AI.

In this lesson you will see why Python is a great first language and what the learning path looks like.

lessons.title: Install and run your first program
lessons.summary: Set up your environment and write your first line of code.
lessons.content:
Install Python and create a file with the py extension.

Your first program can be one line: print('Hello world')

lessons.title: Working with lists
lessons.summary: Keep several values in one variable and manage them.
lessons.content:
Lists hold a collection of values and are written with brackets.

Use append to add items and indexes to access each item.

lessons.title: Loops and conditions
lessons.summary: Learn decisions and repetition in Python.
lessons.content:
Use if to make decisions and for to walk through a list.

These two tools are the backbone of every program.

lessons.title: From goal to daily plan
